title: Shared Surface presentation runtime
summary: A typed public Surface container provides bounded full-bleed geometry, local decorative media and registry-owned nesting through the existing document pipeline.
invariants: Surface is a typed registry-owned container rendered by the existing renderer registry, Smart Gateway, LayoutComposer and PageBuilder.
Width, media, overlay, padding and tone accept only closed values and admitted project-local media.
Child admission is capability-driven with bounded slots, count, order and depth.
Hero semantics and homepage art direction remain unchanged in Goal S1.
